summary: Verified autonomy outcomes and isolated three-node package replication

delivery.outcome: Publish isolated local/live outcome verification and exact-source three-node replication tests with scoped credentials, candidate activation, pinned Paxlet content and bounded failure recovery.
nonGoals: New paid live-model calls in cluster continuation

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing tests ticket after explicit cancelled-owner handoff. Keep offline tests explicitly selected; stage committed pinned inputs into disposable Compose resources. Three real Taskand gateways exchange scoped read credentials. Transfer a source-pinned Paxlet archive through the current flat Taskand package transport; verify/store/materialize at destinations without rebuilding it. Test candidate defaults, explicit activation, offline/rejoin, interrupted imports, conflicts and retries.
architecture.rollback: Remove disposable test containers; retain prior main and source packages unchanged.

validation.evidence: Negative outcome and repair-budget regression tests, isolated container tests, bounded live probe artifacts.
Exact dependency SHAs, bounded isolated three-node report, failure/rejoin assertions and preserved infrastructure CI blocker.
